title: io.loams.dev.usage.storage.logical.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.usage.storage.logical.v1` usage event: A namespace's logical storage, hourly (a gauge, D103). Producer: Worker role. Design §63 §6.3. Measured values are integers in the unit named; dimensions are strings. New optional fields may be added within v1.
